feeds.title: This N That with Olivia
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Olivia, I'm a Lifestyle blogger sharing all sorts of travel ideas, recipes, product reviews, and more! I have a passion for baked goods, organization, decluttering, and more! Our family loves to spend quality time together and create all the memories we can!

feeds.title: Crystal Carder
feeds.description: I'm Crystal, the sole author and writer of this blog! I got married when I was 18 and have been married to my husband, Michael, for 11 wonderful years. Here at Crystal Carder, we're sharing flaws, talking about our families, our lives, and living our adventures.

feeds.title: The Shirley Journey
feeds.description: The blog is a guide to navigating family life and motherhood, with parenting tips, travel advice, and confidence-boosting celebrations.

feeds.title: Sunshine Whispers
feeds.description: Family Travel, Adventures and Fun. I am Christian Mom who works outside the home and tries to maximize family time with my daughter through fun adventures and fun at home!

feeds.title: Journeys with Jenn
feeds.description: Jenn is a mom, writer, marketer, small business owner and social media influencer. She loves to travel- solo, with her family or with a group of friends. No matter where she is, she is always making an impact and sharing her journey.

feeds.title: Woven by Words
feeds.description: I'm Mimi Noble. My blog, Woven by Words started off as a Christian book review blog, but has become more than that. Now I share day to day topics, photos, life, and family friendly product reviews.

feeds.title: Food Fun Family
feeds.description: A family lifestyle blog about food, family, entertainment, travel and family-friendly products by Laura. She is been blogging since October 2007. She grew up in California, graduated from High School in Oregon, went to college in Utah, and settled in Maryland (outside of Washington D.C.) to raise her kids.

feeds.title: Moms With Tots
feeds.description: I'm Shelly and not 'just' the creator of Moms with Tots. I am the wife of a design genius, the mother of a charismatic son, and a shy but sassy daughter. This blog is a hub for activities, events, and resources for families with young children. I feature local handpicked events, activities, and resources in the Maryland area and beyond.

feeds.title: Maryland Momma's Rambles
feeds.description: I'm Ashley, a lifestyle Mom Blogger. I love my son, bourbon, running, and baseball. I always eat tacos on Tuesday. Also, I am a Disney / Marvel fan with a tactical side. This blog deals with Lifestyle, recipes, entertainment, and more.

feeds.title: Baltimore County Moms Blog
feeds.description: We are here to be your go-to resource for everything in and around The Baltimore Moms Network community! It is a hyper-local platform providing access to information about everything and anything that is Baltimore County. The goal of this site is to save moms and dads time and to become your go-to resource and connection to the county.
